name: trimwrit
description: trimwrit, which makes a harness rule earn its place with a test, and nine gates, each with its tests and, for the Stop gates, the eval case that measures it.

plugins.name: trimwrit
plugins.description: A harness rule enters with a test and leaves when the test passes without it.

plugins.name: no-em-dash
plugins.description: Refuses a final message, a file write or a shell write that carries an em dash, an en dash, a figure dash or a horizontal bar. The characters are configurable.

plugins.name: explicit-subagent-model
plugins.description: Refuses an Agent or Task call that names no model, so a subagent never silently inherits whatever /model last set.

plugins.name: resume-on-api-error
plugins.description: When a turn ends on an API error, types a continue message into the GNU screen or tmux pane hosting the session, after a delay; never on an authentication or billing error.

plugins.name: claim-gate
plugins.description: Refuses to end a turn whose final message claims a gesture done (pushed, merged, sent, deployed, tests pass, verified) with no tool result in the same turn that proves it.

plugins.name: promise-gate
plugins.description: Once the user sets a target (never stop, until results, do the whole pool), refuses to end a turn on a promise to continue instead of doing the next batch.

plugins.name: rule-gate
plugins.description: Refuses to end a turn that announces a new behavioural rule (from now on, never again, every X must) without naming the code that enforces it.

plugins.name: main-checkout-guard
plugins.description: Refuses destructive git on the main checkout of a repository opted into worktree isolation (.claude/auto-worktree): checkout or restore over local changes, reset --hard, clean, stash drops, history rewrites, force pushes of the default branch. Reads the whole bash command, aliases and subshells included.

plugins.name: no-third-party-pr
plugins.description: Refuses opening a pull request on a GitHub repository you do not own, whatever form the command takes (gh, gh api, curl, a script, an alias); one optional exemption command decides the exceptions.

plugins.name: worktree-kit
plugins.description: One session, one git worktree: on a repository opted in with .claude/auto-worktree, a session starting on the main checkout is told to move into a worktree, edits on the main checkout are refused, the worktree gets the gitignored config files linked in, and at session end a clean branch is rebased and pushed when the repository's own gate passes.
